I can honestly say that I did not expect those perf improvements against the m4. Surprisingly using my M4 Air with Chrome + VSCode + OpenCode, I'm able to hit throttling limits after a couple hours of usage. My next upgrade path will likely be the 24gig M5 Pro.
As someone who bought a base M1 Air, a couple months after it was made available, I did not think I'd be so bought-in to this workflow, 5+ years later. Whilst, I'm not a fan of their iPhone line-up and the choice made on iOS, I can happily say that Apple cooked with these M-series chips. My friends and colleagues have told me about about the horrible experience they've had on Windows and having to fight the OS to get work done, while I've had a rock-solid system that kinda just works.
